subject: Invitation to Annual Company Networking Event
body: Dear valued employees, We are excited to invite you to our annual company networking event on Friday, December 10th at 6:00 PM. It will be a great opportunity to connect with colleagues, meet new faces, and enjoy a fun evening together. Please RSVP by November 30th, and feel free to bring a guest. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
